53401.meaning1: originating from illusion; with delusion as source

53403.commentary: (SNa) mohanīyā'ti mohappaccayā udakaṃ gahetvā telakaraṇaṃ, telaṃ gahetvā udakakaraṇan'ti evam'ādayo māyāpabhedā. (NIDD1a) mohanīye na muyhatī'ti mohanīyasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ na mohaṃ uppādeti.

examples.text: rajanīye rajjati, dussanīye dussati, mohanīye muyhati, kuppanīye kuppati, madanīye majjati.

53404.commentary: (ANa) mohaneyyesū'ti mohajanakesu ārammaṇesu. (ITIa) mohaneyyesu mucchito'ti mohasaṃvattaniyesu rūp'ādīsu mucchito sammatto ajjhopanno. (JAa) mohaneyyesū'ti kāmaguṇesu. kāmaguṇesu hi loko muyhati, te ca lokaṃ mohayanti, tasmā te mohaneyyā'ti vuccantī'ti.

examples.text: kummaggappaṭipanno so, mohaneyyesu mucchito, abhabbo tādiso bhikkhu, phuṭṭhuṃ sambodhim'uttamaṃ.

examples.text: paroparaṃ ariyadhammaṃ viditvā, mā mohayī jānam'anomavīriya, vāriṃ yathā ghammani ghammatatto, vāc'ābhikaṅkhāmi sutaṃ pavassa.

siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahāyaññaṃ yajamānassa koci'd'eva vippaṭisāro, mahā vata me bhogakkhandho vigacchatī'ti, so bhotā raññā vippaṭisāro na karaṇīyo
ye sattasaṇḍaṃ pathaviṃ vijitvā, rāj'isayo yajamān'ānupariyagā, assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷaṃ.

53484.meaning1: encourages another to sacrifice; makes others perform sacrifices

examples.text: yaññaṃ yajāma'pi yajāpema'pi. tatra, bho gotama, yo c'eva yajati yo ca yajāpeti sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññappaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti, yadidaṃ yaññ'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

53485.meaning1: making sacrifice; causing (others) to offer alms

examples.text: uttarañ'ce'pi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento, yajanto yajāpento, atthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo.

53486.meaning2: sacrificed, gave away alms or gifts

53487.meaning2: sacrificed, bestowed, given away alms or gifts

53488.meaning1: to sacrifice; to make a sacrificial offering
53488.meaning2: to sacrifice; to make a sacrificial offering

examples.text: icchāmi c'āhaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yajituṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tividhaṃ yaññasampadaṃ soḷasaparikkhāraṃ puccheyyan'ti.

53489.meaning1: having offered a sacrifice; have made a sacrificial offering
53489.meaning2: having sacrificed, having given away alms or gifts

examples.text: yo yajati tividhaṃ yaññasampadaṃ, ārādhaye dakkhiṇeyyebhi tādi, evaṃ yajitvā sammā yācayogo, upapajjati brahmalokan'ti brūmī'ti.
abhijānām'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajitvā vā yājetvā vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjitā, ahaṃ tena samayena purohito brāhmaṇo ahosiṃ tassa yaññassa yājetā'ti.

53490.meaning1: having given alms; having offered charity
53490.meaning2: having given away alms or gifts

examples.text: evaṃ yajitvā medhāvī, saddho muttena cetasā, abyābajjhaṃ sukhaṃ lokaṃ, paṇḍito upapajjatī'ti.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ iruvedaṃ yajuvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ athabbaṇavedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ iti'h'āsaṃ purāṇaṃ nighaṇḍu keṭubhaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

53493.meaning1: but whatever; but whoever; and whichever

examples.text: yañ'ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vuccati cittaṃ iti'pi mano iti'pi viññāṇaṃ iti'pi tatr'āssutavā puthujjano n'ālaṃ nibbindituṃ n'ālaṃ virajjituṃ n'ālaṃ vimuccituṃ
evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.
māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.
seyyo ayoguḷo bhutto, tatto aggisikh'ūpamo, yañ'ce bhuñjeyya dussīlo, raṭṭhapiṇḍam'asaññato.

tasmiṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe n'eva gāvo haññiṃsu, na aj'eḷakā haññiṃsu, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññiṃsu, na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūp'atthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihis'atthāya
te ce n'ātariṃsu yājayogā, yaññehi jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, atha ko carahi devamanussaloke, atāri jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

53497.meaning1: time of the sacrifice; time for the offering
53497.meaning2: time of the sacrifice; time for the offering
53497.commentary: (DNa) yaññakālo mahārājā'ti deyyadhammasmiñ'hi asati mahallakakāle ca evarūpaṃ dānaṃ dātuṃ na sakkā, tvaṃ pana mahādhano c'eva taruṇo ca, etena te yaññakālo'ti dassentā vadanti.

examples.text: yajataṃ bhavaṃ rājā yaññaṃ, yaññakālo mahārājā'ti.

53498.meaning1: sake of sacrifice; purpose of offering

examples.text: yaññ'atthaṃ vā dhan'atthaṃ vā, ye hanāma mayaṃ pure, avase taṃ bhayaṃ hoti, vedhanti vilapanti ca.

tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti, pañca ca usabhasatāni pañca ca vacchatarasatāni pañca ca vacchatarisatāni pañca ca ajasatāni pañca ca urabbhasatāni thūṇ'ūpanītāni honti yaññ'atthāya.

53499.grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of yaññattha

examples.text: so evam'āha, ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā ajā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā assā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā rukkhā chijjantu yūp'atthāya, ettakā dabbhā lūyantu barihis'atthāyā'ti.

tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti, pañca ca usabhasatāni pañca ca vacchatarasatāni pañca ca vacchatarisatāni pañca ca ajasatāni pañca ca urabbhasatāni thūṇ'ūpanītāni honti yaññ'atthāya.
